label: Preface paradox: shared-plus-local error profiles, cross-checks and coverage-explicit elimination
summary: Issue #1584, analyst formulation with attribution deferred (Makinson 1965, Bovens-Olsson 2000 navigation only). Reuse check: truth related on the #1063 threshold and ReflectiveCoherence statements found no prior preface result; #1063 (support bound, uniform lottery), #1066 (product sampling) and #1396 (paired corroboration criterion) were reused as context rather than rebuilt. Built one stipulated model: Mathlib product of a shared common-mode coordinate with n i.i.d. local coordinates; local check flags blind to the shared coordinate. Certified: exact event probabilities; equal per-assertion probability q gives joint q under shared-only dependence and q^n<q under isolated errors, and repeated evidence conditions like one copy (tests 1-2); after conditioning on no flag the all-true probability is kappa(G)(nu(C and not F)/nu(not F))^n <= kappa(G), each assertion kappa(G)nu(C and not F)/nu(not F), perfect local detection leaves exactly the shared risk and blocks Makinson tension above 1/2, truth-independent flags change nothing (test 3); inconsistency eliminates at every world and a survivor needs an explicit coverage premise, refuted without it by the existing two-world control (test 4); shared-only dependence blocks Makinson tension above 1/2 at every n while any local error restores acceptance of 'some false' for large n (test 5). Rejected inferences: per-assertion probability plus count determines joint support; dependence alone removes the preface; more checks always add support; local coherence certifies shared commitments; consistency-elimination identifies a true survivor without coverage. Provisional judgment: the owner's comparative hypothesis survives in sharpened form; interconnection weakens the count-driven preface argument only insofar as cross-checks discriminate local errors, and residual risk concentrates on shared commitments. Standing rival: common-mode checks; its price is showing which actual checks are truth-independent. No probability assigned to any Truth Core statement; no root premise discharged. blocker: Partial-dependence networks (several overlapping shared nodes), a threshold result for imperfect checkers, and the application question whether specific Truth Core checks are discriminating for a given error type remain open. Connection to #930/#931/#934 is a plan, not a route.
